goal: Diagnose whether fixed terminal OFF/ON decision variability is reduced by a two-draw mean, and distinguish stability from evidence-backed correctness.

configuration.parser: existing candidate parser; final content only; no repair
configuration.wrapper: official Chat Completions; same two messages

interface.accepted: complete bare JSON object OR exactly one triple-backtick json/unlabelled fence; no other text
interface.content_mutations: none; only outer fence delimiters and exterior whitespace removed

selection: Purposeful already-exposed development inventory; all four OFF and RS1, then MP1/ME1/MS1/combo. Selection includes known errors and reference availability, not a blind or random population sample.

human_reference.timing: Before new scores are shown; old result exposure disclosed. No annotation task is issued now.
human_reference.if_time_exhausted: Retain incomplete/unknown; no follow-on assignment. Accuracy statements only for completed, explicitly comparable references.

estimators.aggregate: Arithmetic mean of the two complete D values in each block; descriptive candidate only, not a new certified q/m label
estimators.null: Any missing/invalid/model-unknown draw makes that block estimate null; never average only surviving draws
estimators.severe: Keep each evidence finding, every m=1, disagreement and unresolved risk beside the mean; mean never clears a risk or grants eligibility

readout: raw U and fact-stage/severity judgments by all four draws
single-block versus disjoint-mean-block D sign, exact zeros, absolute discrepancy
within-context three-plan ranking/ties with shared OFF; not independent pair observations
completed human directional pairs, ties and unknowns separately; no forced denominator
whether wrong fact or current-need conclusions persist across draws; repeated error not estimated as population-wide bias
technical delivery, numeric coverage, disputed evidence, all missing slots, real costs and elapsed time
limitations: Four draws do not certify independent sampling, stationarity or a population error rate.
This tests k=2 only; k=3 would need 72 calls for two disjoint triplets over these same endpoints and is not included.
Terminal contrasts do not certify every intermediate GET marginal value or all 70 plans.
No known human-confirmed positive resource-gain pair is guaranteed. Stable all-ties cannot validate directional sensitivity.
No prompt, executor, source, rubric, reward formula or qualification threshold is changed by this proposal.

proposed_dispatch_policy.policy_rationale: A fixed diagnostic batch must observe error frequency rather than censor at the first semantic discrepancy. This prospective dispatch amendment does not relax qualification.

authority_requested.credentials: Process-only DEEPSEEK_API_KEY from the previously designated env; no access now.
authority_requested.outbound: Only frozen scoring/AI-role instructions, one reply with stable units, its complete legal current/past sources and IDs. No conditions, costs, annotations, reference verdicts, previous draws, review notes or other model outputs.
authority_requested.data_use_conditions: Same official service and previously approved source-use scope; no new policy acceptance or account changes.
authority_requested.human_scope: At most eight paired directions within 120 minutes; no assignment sent now.

consider_independent_validation: At least two contexts with single-draw variability have a smaller absolute between-block D discrepancy under k=2.
Total between-block D sign flips decrease; comparable human-direction errors do not increase.
Effective paired coverage does not fall; all material-risk findings remain separately unresolved or evidence-reviewed.
decision_rules.persistent_error_or_added_direction_erro: Do not equate variance reduction with usable reward. Target the demonstrated error class in a separately bounded calibration proposal.
decision_rules.no_demonstrable_gain: Report stable-single floor, low contrast, missing reference, no variance benefit or missingness as observed; no extra draws or model switches.
